scored_features.gate_reasoning: G1: TRUE — 'age' is explicitly listed in trial_measured_features for IST-3, so the feature was measured in the trial. G2: FALSE — the submitted mechanisms only invoke higher baseline cardiovascular risk, disease burden, competing risks or altered event trajectories with age and do not name any concrete biological steps (receptor, enzyme, PK/PD change, or specific pathophysiologic chain) linking age to differential alteplase action; G2 FALSE — cascade: G3..G5 also FALSE. G3: FALSE — because no specific pharmacodynamic, pharmacokinetic or pathophysiologic mechanism is proposed that would make alteplase act differently by age beyond simple absolute-risk amplification. G4: FALSE — no specific published clinical evidence or cited RCT subgroup analyses supporting a biologically grounded age×alteplase interaction is provided here. G5: FALSE — the hypotheses define only broad age strata and prognostic differences without clear, operational treatment recommendations, so they are not clinically actionable.
scored_features.justification: Decisive failure at G2: the proposals are prognostic/absolute-risk statements without any named biological mechanism (receptor/PK/PD/pathway) to explain why alteplase would work differently by age, so downstream gates must be FALSE.
